objective: Turn one explicit request for unavailable research code into a reproducible public release and a useful maintainer response, without treating the interaction as a sale or publishing uncleared recordings.

source_evidence.observed_need: A repository visitor explicitly asked when the implementation would be available.

included: canonical model, training, preprocessing, and evaluation source
deterministic CPU unit and end-to-end smoke tests
citation metadata and eleven complete README languages
delivery.boundary: The smoke run proves that the public pipeline executes with finite outputs. It is not an alignment benchmark, calibration result, customer outcome, or permission to redistribute private captures.

github.policy: The exact requested release and runnable commands are already in the thread. Reopen or answer a new issue if a reproducible setup failure appears; do not add a sales pitch, move the requester to private messages, or infer buying intent from a code request.

funnel.policy: A code request, repository star, issue reply, CI pass, or future technical acknowledgement is not a commercial lead or received revenue.
